# workspace_provision_tool

> Self-provision a development workspace for an agent.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `developer` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=workspace_provision_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Self-provision a development workspace for an agent. Reads the tenant's dev_team
Configuration to determine the repo URL, Docker image, and host details, then
creates a CodeWorkspace record, clones the repo, and starts a container.

This tool is designed for agent dev teams — each agent gets its own isolated
workspace with a separate repo clone, Docker container, and git branch.

Operations:
- provision: Create workspace, clone repo, start container (idempotent — returns existing if healthy)
- status: Check workspace and container health
- reset: Destroy and re-provision from scratch (fresh clone)
- destroy: Tear down container and workspace

EXAMPLES:

Provision a workspace (auto-reads tenant config):
{operation: "provision", agent_name: "Sally"}

Check workspace status:
{operation: "status", agent_name: "Sally"}

Reset workspace (fresh clone):
{operation: "reset", agent_name: "Sally"}

Destroy workspace:
{operation: "destroy", agent_name: "Sally"}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | string | yes | Workspace operation to perform. One of: `provision`, `status`, `reset`, `destroy`. |
| `agent_name` | string | yes | Name of the agent to provision workspace for. Used to generate a unique workspace slug. |
